summary: SiteDocument represents a site-attached document within the HSPnet system. It is a data layer class primarily used for storing and referencing documents by SiteID.
purpose: To encapsulate the storage and retrieval of documents associated with a site, identified by SiteID. Used for organizing and managing site-specific documentation.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site to which the document is attached.

system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are serialized and deserialized as part of site document management.
content_gaps: No information on storage details, retrieval mechanisms, or UI integration.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page in HSPnet that presents staff administrators with a welcome screen, last login details, and error or warning information.
purpose: To welcome staff administrators, display last login information, and provide feedback through warnings and error panels.

fields.name: lblTitle
fields.description: Displays welcome text and user first name.

workflows.name: Display Welcome and Login Info
steps: On page load, display welcome text including user's preferred first name.
Show last login details and time zone if available.
If errors or warnings exist, display them in the appropriate panel.

conditions: Last login panel only visible if last login exists.
system_behavior: Client-side scripts for WelcomeStaffAdmin and Date functions are included.
Panels and labels auto-generated, fields must be moved for code customization.
content_gaps: No information on user actions or interaction beyond display logic.

summary: ServiceCode and ServiceCodes represent a system for describing, storing, and retrieving codes for services associated with courses and timetables.
purpose: To provide a list and options for service codes, including sorting, localization, and grouping by course or timetable.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: NameAlt
fields.description: Alternative service code description when in alt-language.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Query ServiceCodeListAll or specific options by CourseID or TimetableID using related stored procedures.
Localize fields if alt-language mode is active.

business_rules: Use alt-language fields if session is in alt-language mode.
system_behavior: ServiceCodes objects retrieve and localize service code lists as needed.
Stored procedures provide main listing interface.

summary: SiteProfileHistory captures a record of changes made to a Site's profile, including user actions, fields changed, and agent details. Histories are retrieved and formatted for display and auditing.
purpose: To record, display, and audit Site profile changes, including who made the changes, what was changed, and when.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: If user was a system admin.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: SiteProfileHistorySearch stored procedure retrieves changes for site and agency session.
Populate SiteProfileHistory records with change details.
Format and display records for auditing.

business_rules: Display support team attribution if change was made by someone other than original user and not system admin.
Fields are localized if session is in alt-language mode.
Display formatted name, agency, and phone if available.
system_behavior: Records are formatted with ActionDate and agency/user details.
content_gaps: No actual stored procedure or database schema details.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a data layer class that represents documents associated with popup email functionality, including file name, path, and checked status. It supports searching and deletion of such documents.
purpose: To facilitate saving, searching, and deletion of documents for email popup features, enabling users to select and manage files for email attachments.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Whether the document is checked for action.

workflows.name: Search and Delete Email Popup Documents
steps: Search: Split DataInfo and create EmailPopupDocument objects.
Delete: Remove file and its folder, update info.

system_behavior: Handles file deletion and document management within email popup context.
exceptions: Catches errors during file and folder deletion.
content_gaps: UI not described; no actor/method usage context.

summary: CostCentre manages the retrieval and representation of cost center data associated with placements, including placing agency, discipline, site, service, destination, costs and hours.
purpose: To provide detailed cost center reporting for placements, including filters and aggregation of hours, counts, and related fields.

workflows.name: Get Cost Centre Data
steps: Populate CostCentreRecord for each result row.

system_behavior: Aggregates placement and student counts and hours by cost centre and related fields.
content_gaps: No UI, actor, or business decision rules described.
